annotations.title: EU CBAM & EUDR Statutory Scope Gate

description: Check EU CBAM (Regulation (EU) 2023/956 and 2025/2083 50-tonne threshold) and EUDR (Regulation (EU) 2023/1115) CN/HS scope and WGS84 polygon rules. Read-only diagnostic gate; zero emissions math.

annual_mass_tonnes.description: Cumulative annual net mass imported into the EU customs territory in metric tonnes.

cn_or_hs_code.description: 4-to-8 digit EU Combined Nomenclature (CN) or Harmonized System (HS) commodity code.

geojson_ring_closed.description: Whether the WGS84 GeoJSON exterior coordinate ring is topologically closed.

plot_hectares.description: Production plot area in hectares (triggers EUDR Art. 9 polygon vs point rule at 4.0 ha).

query_note.description: Optional non-sensitive context note for diagnostic scope triage.

regime.description: Target European Union border compliance regime to evaluate: 'cbam', 'eudr', or 'both'.
